headline: Top 25 citizen complaints this week in Austin

items.text: PUPPIES AND POSTPARTUM MOM IN DANGER NEED HELP - the mother dog and her puppies living in a shopping cart. Her bag is now covering the puppies in the shopping cart but you can see them from the side in person. A rescue lady has been trying to help since May and needs help. She said homeless people say she is mentally unwell.THE PUPPIES AND MOM WILL DIE IN THIS HEAT. DO SOMETHING. i would go myself

The Rhodesian Ridgebacks from the 44 East Ave condos are off leash again. When are you doing something about it? When something serious happens? Isn't it enough that people can't walk their dogs in peace? Here is his number AGAIN 408-391-0979
Ramsey park homeless camp expands: multiple men occupying restrooms, sleeping on picnic tables, passed out on bleachers by ball field.  Please let us have our park back!!!

this dog has been loose for a week in pioneer crossing west. several people report this dog snd then he goes home. then loose the next day. his name is cyclone and owner is Adrian Lopez. hes not taking care of the dog snd needs a new home. this dog will eventually get hit or die of heat stroke. please do something about this. several people reported this dog loose. the owner is not fit to own a do

Mary Street roundabout close to Lamar is closed. Area residents would like to know when it will be open again.  I called this in on June 4 26-00181354 and it was closed without any information to me.  Can you please tell me the estimated date range of when Mary will be open again?  It has been closed for a very very long time with no information to the residents.

Ran up to me and my dogs on our daily walk and attempted to attack my dogs AGAIN. Both then ran into traffic. This is my 3rd report. They have repeatedly come after me and my dogs on our morning walks. They have repeatedly run into traffic. A previous instance was so aggressive, a car passing by tried to run them over to help me.

I am requesting maintenance for the city-owned park land located at 5503 Bennett Ave, Austin, TX. The lot is significantly overgrown with tall grass, weeds, and/or vegetation that has not been maintained. As a city-owned property, this land should be regularly mowed and kept clear in accordance with city maintenance standards. Please schedule a crew to mow and clear the overgrowth at this location

One of the plastic lane dividers on oltorf, a little west of I-35, is bent over hanging into the inner east bound lane.  It damaged the paint on my vehicle.  Please send insurance information and compensation to John Dukes.  jwdukes@gmail.com 361-550-4949

New owner of Courtyard Racquet Club Development in our P.U.D.  (incorrectly Zoned as a “remodel” at 5608 Courtyard Drive) has caused stormwater runoff Drainage problems in our backyard all the way up to our foundation and surrounding our A/C unit in our backyard at 5602 Parade Rdg  78731.  
The newly constructed tennis courts are longer (towards the homes along Parade Rdg in our restrictive P.U.D.

The construction site at 4816 Aberdeen is messy and dangerous.  Not only is the sidewalk covered with dirt and stones from the day’s work (it is not swept at the end of the work day), now the stacked lumber is well into the sidewalk.  This is not ADA compliant, nor is it basic user-friendly for the many neighbors who walk on this street.

Both left turn lanes from WB290 to William Canon have been blocked all weekend and now into the week. It is causing major backup and folks are dangerously weaving through the construction barrels and intersection, as there is no better way through. The lane signage is inaccurate and makes the problem worse.

Whilst I appreciate Mexico won a World Cup game tonight  the drumming and shouting and loud music is deafening and yet again we can not get any rest. I believe it is coming from both The Flower Shop and a bar next door to Cenote on 7th. Please send someone out to sort this out. I am so sorry to be complaining yet again but it is impossible to get any sleep.

Every Thursday night some bar or bars do not adhere to the 11pm cutoff time on W 6th. It’s always loud music with pounding bass. Location is only a guess at the general area. Specific venue unknown but there’s only a few short blocks. Just follow your ears. Please send enforcement before tomorrow.

the rock pit for toddlers by the playground has lost almost all of its rocks and needs to be refilled. It used to be filled all the way up to the level of the grout. This is a danger for kids falling down the slope that is there now that there are no rocks.

Entire front yard and back yard covered in junked cars parked on non impervious ground. Has been an issue for a long time, extremely dangerous for the ground with many chemicals spilling. Trying to sell cars without registrations. more cars than allowed per code per person. 800 sq ft 1 bd house with 8+ cars

Small green belt behind my house is overgrown. Poison ivy keeps coming through my fence line. I have multiple wildlife digging up my yard from skunks (5+) raccoons (3+) possums (3+) coyotes (2+). I have already spent $350 hiring pest control to capture & relocate wildlife. I can’t afford to keep doing this. Please come cut and clean this area out. The skunks have sprayed my neighbors pets.

There is a large pothole forming on West Ave in the southbound lane right where 7th St comes into it. West Ave surfacec was redone in front of Cirrus Logic, but this is just north of it. A new "slow down" street barrier was just installed nearby which makes traffic drive directly over it. This pothole is getting worse and will be losing pavement and turning into a real hole soon. Needs a good deep

Completed. Hello, the traffice light at 290/Giles lane seems to be off. Coming 290 south/east and turning under the overpass, the light is green for a few seconds, turns red for a few seconds, then green again. This disrupts traffic flow and has already caused a few near hits. Please review. Thank you.

items.text: Creek bed behind 7629 Rockpoint Dr Austin 78731 has blocked water flow due to several fallen tree’s. Austin Watershed was notified on May 26,2026 on service request # 26-00164680. Complete removal and clearing off all tree’s, limbs and debris needs to be cleared immediately as future flooding is very likely.

On Johnny Morris Rd driving towards 969 the dog is lying on the right side of the road. The black dog could still be missing or found by owner. I have no idea. They also have a baby and a cat. This couple leaves their dog outside all day and night in extreme weather. Park maintenance
Mowing 
Cleaning

Uneven, high risk trip and fall surface . Today a participant in a city program tripped and fell on this uneven concrete slab. She twisted her ankle and was in pain.  Participant reported that years ago her elderly mom also tripped and fell in the same spot. Our high school intern also tripped on the same spot this week. The incidents happened at the Zilker Park Playscape Shelter.

this house persistently leaves full garbage bins in sidewalk and bike lanes for days on end, obstructing use of sidewalk. I moved the bins somewhat to clear up use of the sidewalk. This house does this all the time, and never sucks it up and keeps the bins on their driveway/property where it belongs.

I was turning left from the northbound MoPac frontage road to northbound Parmer Lane. A slow-moving homeless person was crossing the approach of the intersection, which made me swerve even with cars next to me and my vehicle’s pre-collision assist turned on. The light was green and stayed green the entire time from my approach to the turn onto Parmer.
